name: principles-disciple
description: Owner-governed behavior internalization for Codex: injects approved principles into prompts, gates risky tool calls with owner-approved rules, and records pain evidence — all reviewable and reversible.

interface.shortDescription: Owner-governed principles that actually steer Codex
interface.longDescription: Principles Disciple turns your corrections into durable behavior: approved principles are injected into session context, owner-approved rules can deny risky tool calls before they run, and failed tool calls are recorded as reviewable evidence. Use $pd-control for explicit setup/disable/enable requests, $pd-cli-operator to troubleshoot health, and $pd-review to open the Owner Console. Normal PD behavior should not require users to invoke a skill by name; explicit feedback uses the host's supported Owner pain-entry format.
